notes: Elm Street's west line is in the margin (sheet 218/209 strip), so Elm points use the east block line minus half of 66 ft (~203 px). Henry, Forbus and Elder west of Elm sit on other alignments: water-pipe stubs in the west margin show Henry (218 part) meeting Elm at about y1900, Forbus (218 part) at y3428 and Elder (209 part) at y6952; these are not recorded here because only pipes are drawn. Findlay continues straight across Elm. Pleasant jogs at Henry: the 20' north part is centred ~40 px east of the 30' south part; point is the midpoint. Forbus Alley meets Race opposite Addy Alley (one crossing, recorded as two T entries at the same place). Elder Street west of Race is split into two 45' roadways around the Findlay Market house: the north roadway is labelled ELDER (y~6680); the south roadway (y~7250, recorded as '?') carries no name here. East of Race, Elder (50') is centred on the market house line (y~6980), so Race has three T points. Hazen Alley north of Henry is the sheet-219 Hazen Alley; south of Henry it resumes only south of Findlay (block 6), offset ~145 px west. Hafer Alley is the unnamed 10' alley of sheet 219 continuing south across Henry to Forbus; it resumes south of Findlay (block 7) to Horton. W. Clifton Av. meets Vine near the top right; the point is the Clifton centreline (midway between its building lines), not the pipe junction, which is ~100 px further north. A street leaves Vine to the SE just below Clifton in the 'See Volume Two' area (no name printed, only partly drawn) and is not recorded. W. McMicken Av. merges into Vine south of Findlay; Findlay ends at McMicken. The Race/McMicken/Ohio junction at the top (sheet-219 area) is shown only by water pipes here and is not recorded. Unnamed alleys: two 12' alleys run Bremen to Vine and a 10' alley Goose to Bremen. Webster Public School block and the market house are not streets.
